verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs say its core engines, Chandra, Marker and Surya, 'remain free open source', so some of the underlying source is readable. The hosted platform itself (pipelines, extraction, form filling, Forge) appears proprietary: running its models on your own infrastructure requires an Enterprise contract. Missing for 10: named license terms, repository links, evidence that the platform/SDK/CLI source is open, independent corroboration of the open-source claim.
